notes.title: Map Extension
notes.notes:
the 3 phases were reworked

Now it is possible to enter the houses

more places to hide on all maps (cabinets and beds)

humans can't see you properly in the dark

the robot sees you in the dark but loses you more easily

robot shoots the player

monster is slower and becomes much slower when shining the flashlight in its face

store added
(the player earns coins for each level he passes)

new achievement (buy all hats (good luck))

new AI for all enemies

Bugs fixed

collectibles added

new interface in the menu

ESC now works as a pause button

skip cutscene button (only in the first cutscene of the game)

bugs fixed
(enemy did no damage)

new items
medkit, flashlight battery and collectibles

notes.title: Game Officially Released
notes.notes:
The final update consists of adding the game and full DLC.

### Campaign Additions

- You can turn the flashlight off and on to save battery power.
- The human kills you on the spot for having a knife, but he doesn't see you from afar with the flashlight turned off.
- The robot only deals one damage, sees in the dark and, suddenly, can appear behind you.
- There were no changes to the monstrous; It's still as difficult.
- The final boss now launches a continuous beam.

### DLC Additions

- Cutscenes in all stages.
- New conquests.

### Additions in General

- Major bug fix.
